A tiny armored knight creeps in from the cavern mouth, sword drawn, dwarfed to a speck beneath the colossal sleeping dragon.
A small hooded thief reaches for a single jeweled goblet at the edge of the hoard, frozen mid-step.
A would-be hero's skeleton in rusted armor lies half-buried in the gold, a grim warning to the next.
A lone adventurer stands frozen in awe at the hoard's edge, tiny against the mountain of gleaming treasure.
A single glowing dragon-egg nestles deep in the gold, radiating faint warmth among ten thousand cold coins.
A burglar tiptoes across a field of coins, each careful step barely audible beneath the dragon's thunderous breathing.
A robed wizard halts at a distance, staff raised, a mere speck before the colossal slumbering beast.
Two tiny treasure-hunters peek from behind a gilded pillar, wide-eyed, barely visible against the overwhelming hoard.
A small torchbearer pauses at the cavern mouth, flame flickering, silhouetted against an unimaginable wall of gold.
A child-sized thief clutches a single ruby to their chest, retreating on silent feet through the coin drifts.
A fallen paladin's bones rest against a treasure chest, gauntleted hand still gripping a shattered holy sword.
A nimble acrobat creeps along a high ledge of stacked gold bars, infinitely tiny above the dragon's scaled back.
A nervous scout crouches behind an enormous gem, scribbling a hasty map by the faint glow of the hoard.
A grizzled dwarf prospector taps one coin with a small hammer, testing its purity in the dragon's vast shadow.
A hooded figure presses flat against a stalagmite, breath held, as the dragon shifts one enormous claw overhead.
A pair of halflings link hands at the hoard's rim, peering down into the golden depths far below.
A lone rogue dangles from a rope anchored far above, slowly lowering toward a crown jewel in the pile.
A skeletal jester in tattered motley lies sprawled across a mound of coins, bells still attached to rotted boots.
A young apprentice mage kneels at the hoard's edge, furiously sketching the dragon's scales in a tiny notebook.
A crossbow-armed mercenary creeps sideways along the cavern wall, dwarfed by the dragon's single enormous tail behind her.
A tiny fox in an embroidered coat tugs at a single gold chain trailing from the sleeping dragon's talons.
A monk in plain robes meditates at the hoard's distant edge, a calm speck amid mountains of glittering wealth.
A trap-setter crouches low, planting a tiny tripwire across the gold, invisible against the dragon's overwhelming scaled bulk.
A fleeing thief sprints across the coins, arms pumping, one stolen gem clutched tight, the dragon's eye cracking open.
A ghost of a long-dead adventurer drifts near the hoard, translucent and small, still reaching for treasure it cannot touch.
